sections.title: Player text
sections.body: The forest opens into hidden homes: thorn-warren shelters, cook-fires, moss lamps, patched tools, and people who go very quiet when strangers arrive. Whatever happened on the road, this place is not a camp of raiders. It is a community trying not to disappear.

Readaloud: The forest opens into hidden homes: thorn-warren shelters, cook-fires, moss lamps, patched tools, and people who go very quiet when strangers arrive. Whatever happened on the road, this place is not a camp of raiders. It is a community trying not to disappear.
Gmnotes: This is optional content, not the critical path. The villagers can fear the party and still accept help.
Gmscript: Say: "This is what mercy opened: homes, not a hideout. Let the place answer before anyone lectures. You see families, old injuries, repurposed company gear, and a memory wall of names."

Playertakeaway: The forest opens into hidden homes: thorn-warren shelters, cook-fires, moss lamps, patched tools, and people who go very quiet when strangers arrive. Whatever happened on the road, this place is not a camp of raiders. It is a community trying not to disappear.
Storytakeaway: The hidden villages make the attackers' motive human: these were people with homes, families, and losses.
Mechanictakeaway: Mercy creates access: Presence, Knowledge, and careful listening can turn a combat outcome into an ally route.
